propositions: docs/releasing.md and .github/workflows/release.yml incorrectly describe the pypi environment required-reviewers rule as 'the second human approval' when it is single-identity (the configured release identity) with self-review permitted and admin bypass enabled

The runbook incorrectly instructs operators to 'approve the pypi deployment when prompted' interactively, while in practice approval is executed non-interactively via the pending-deployments REST API by the configured release identity

The approval mechanism controls who can release the publish job and its OIDC token (identity + ref control), not independent content review; review comes from the Gerrit-reviewed main branch policy documented elsewhere

The non-interactive approval process requires a POST to pending_deployments with an explicit JSON body that types environment_ids as a JSON array of integers, not field flags, and must be preceded by a GET discovery call
